children: Oil rises in early Asian trade amid elevated concerns over supply disruptions in the Middle East. "Iran's military said it targeted U.S. bases in Kuwait and the UAE," ANZ Research analysts said, citing state-run Islamic Republic News Agency. Kuwait said it responded to missile and drone threats, the analysts say. "The tit-for-tat exchange of strikes is raising concerns of a reversal of the recent recovery in oil flowing through the Strait of Hormuz," the analysts add. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.5% higher at $91.79 per barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
